svg.data-weight: 9.57 kg (21.1 lbs) (data sheet; the guide says 9.6 kg)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 46.9 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.5 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: six ports of 100 Gbps; 12 of 50 Gbps; 6 of 40 Gbps; 12 breakouts of 10 or 25 Gbps. 4 RJ-45 ports of 10 Gbps only; 36 RJ-45 ports of 1 or 10 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: typical at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports (data sheet)
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (guide Table 2); the data sheet says 5 to 95 percent
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G, 50G, 40G, 25G and 10G with breakout, in the six QSFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-rj45: 40 x 10GBASE-T RJ-45, 36 of them 1G or 10G and 4 of them 10G only (data sheet)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the front, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the front
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the front, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA (data sheet)
